conditions: Photon of positive frequency f; frequency and energy are measured in the same inertial frame.
spoken_aliases: photon energy equals planck constant times frequency

evidence: The Planck-Einstein relation assigns energy h f to a photon of frequency f. Equivalently the quantum of angular frequency omega has energy hbar omega; omega=2 pi f and h=2 pi hbar give hf. This is a quantum physical law rather than a purely mathematical theorem.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/6-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
